basic_details.job_title: CUSAT Workshop Superintendent Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Kunjali Marakkar School of Marine Engineering at Cochin University of Science and Technology (CUSAT) is filling one Workshop Superintendent post on contract at a consolidated pay of ₹82,720 per month, for 1 year extendable up to 2 years. The essential qualification is a Marine Engineer with MEO Class II Certificate Competency and at least 6 months' management-level experience onboard a merchant ship. Apply online at recruit.cusat.ac.in on or before 07.12.2026; the signed hard copy must reach the Registrar by 14.12.2026.

how_to_apply: Apply online through the CUSAT website, recruit.cusat.ac.in, on or before 07.12.2026.

Pay the fee online: ₹950/- for General and OBC candidates and ₹195/- for SC/ST candidates. Net banking or Credit / Debit cards of almost all banks are accepted; payment by cash, cheque or DD will not be accepted.

Send the signed hard copy of the uploaded form, with proof of age, educational qualification, experience and community, so that it reaches the Registrar, Administrative Office, Cochin University of Science and Technology, Kochi - 22, on or before 14.12.2026.
Write on the envelope: "Application for the post of Workshop Superintendent in Kunjali Marakkar School of Marine Engineering on contract basis".
Documents named in the notice: proof of age, educational qualification, experience and community.
important_instructions: Late and defective applications will summarily be rejected. All proceedings pursuant to the notification will be subjected to the result of the writ petitions or writ appeals, if any, connected with the matter pending before the Hon'ble High Court of Kerala.

content_sections.heading: About CUSAT
content_sections.text: Cochin University of Science and Technology is a university with its Administrative Office at Kochi - 22, as printed in the notice. The post is in its Kunjali Marakkar School of Marine Engineering. The notice is dated 05.11.2026 and is issued by the Registrar.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The age limit is preferably below 57 and up to a maximum age limit of 62 years as on 01.01.2026. Reservation Rules are applicable for appointment to the post. The notice does not mention any age relaxation.

rows.essential_qualification: Marine Engineer with MEO Class II Certificate Competency with an experience of a minimum of 6 months in management level onboard merchant ship

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries a consolidated pay of ₹82,720/- per month. The appointment will be on contract basis for a period of 1 (one) year, extendable up to 2 years.

faq.question: Q1. How many Workshop Superintendent posts are vacant at CUSAT?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for the post of Workshop Superintendent on contract in the Kunjali Marakkar School of Marine Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the CUSAT Workshop Superintendent post?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted on or before 07.12.2026, and the signed hard copy must reach the Registrar on or before 14.12.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for CUSAT Workshop Superintendent?
faq.answer: A Marine Engineer with MEO Class II Certificate Competency with a minimum of 6 months' experience in management level onboard a merchant ship. Workshop experience is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CUSAT Workshop Superintendent post?
faq.answer: Preferably below 57 and up to a maximum age limit of 62 years as on 01.01.2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the CUSAT Workshop Superintendent?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay is ₹82,720/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹950/- for General and OBC candidates and ₹195/- for SC/ST candidates, payable online. Cash, cheque or DD will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the CUSAT Workshop Superintendent post?
faq.answer: Apply online at recruit.cusat.ac.in, then send the signed hard copy of the uploaded form with proof of age, educational qualification, experience and community to the Registrar, Administrative Office, CUSAT, Kochi - 22.

faq.question: Q8. Is the CUSAT Workshop Superintendent post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the appointment is on contract basis for 1 (one) year, extendable up to 2 years.
